name: RunInstances

parameters.help_en: The instance type
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the instance. Valid values:

- **PrePaid**: subscription

- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：
- **PrePaid**：预付费，包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The image ID. This parameter is required for all instance types except for ARM-based ones
parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。arm版卡不能填，其他类型规格必填
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The district code.

> This parameter is required for regional scheduling and is invalid for node-level scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
地区Code。
>区域级调度时必填，节点级调度时无效
parameters.name: net_district_code

parameters.help_en:
The carrier. > This parameter is required for regional scheduling.
For node-level scheduling, if you do not specify a carrier for a node that supports multiple carriers, the system creates instances with all supported carriers. For example, if a node supports both China Mobile and China Unicom, the created instances will have two carriers.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html operation to obtain the carrier information of a node
parameters.help_zh:
运营商。
>区域级调度时必填。</br>
>在节点级调度时如果是节点存在多运营商场景时，如果不输入运营商则会按节点的运营商进行生产，如有移动、联通两个运营商，则生产出来的实例有两个ISP。</br>您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2637461.html获取节点运营商信息
parameters.name: carrier

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling level. This determines whether to perform regional or node-level scheduling. Valid values:

- **Big**: large area

- **Middle**: province

- **Small**: city

- **Region**: node
parameters.help_zh:
调度层级。通过该字段来执行节点级调度或者区域调度。取值：

- **Big**：大区
- **Middle**：省份
- **Small**：城市
- **Region**：节点
parameters.name: schedule_area_level

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

- **Concentrate**: concentrated deployment

- **Disperse**: dispersed deployment

> For node-level scheduling, set this parameter to **Concentrate**. For regional scheduling, select a strategy based on your business requirements
parameters.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

- **Concentrate**：集中
- **Disperse**：分散

> 节点级调度时，为**Concentrate**；区域级调度时，按客户需求选择
parameters.name: scheduling_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node.

> This parameter is required for node-level scheduling and is invalid for regional scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

> 节点级调度时必填，区域级调度时无效
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance password.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码。

> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。
> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for bandwidth. Valid values:

- **BandwidthByDay**: pay-by-day peak bandwidth

- **95BandwidthByMonth**: pay-by-monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

> You can select a billing method only when you purchase an instance for the first time. For subsequent purchases, the system uses the previously selected billing method by default
parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
- **BandwidthByDay**：日峰值带宽
- **95BandwidthByMonth**：月95峰值带宽

> 如果是第一次新购时可以进行选择计费方式，后续此字段值会根据第一次所选择的计费方式进行默认处理
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The size of the system disk, in GiB
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The category of the system disk
fields.name: category

parameters.help_en: The system disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘规格
parameters.name: system_disk

element_fields.help_en: The size of the data disk, in GiB
element_fields.name: size

element_fields.help_en:
The category of the data disk. Valid values:

- **cloud\_efficiency**: Ultra Disk

- **cloud\_ssd**: standard SSD

- **local\_hdd**: local HDD

- **local\_ssd**: local SSD
element_fields.help_zh:
磁盘种类。取值：
- **cloud_efficiency**：高效云盘
- **cloud_ssd**：全闪云盘
- **local_hdd**：本地HDD盘
- **local_ssd**：本地SSD盘
element_fields.name: category

element_fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the data disk. Valid values:

- true: The data disk is encrypted.

- false (default): The data disk is not encrypted
element_fields.help_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

- true：是

- false（默认值）：否
element_fields.name: encrypted

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the KMS key to use for the data disk. Valid values:

- true: yes

- false (default): no

> If Encrypted is set to true but KMSKeyId is left empty, the default service key is used
element_fields.help_zh:
云盘使用的KMS密钥ID。取值范围：

- true：是

- false（默认值）：否

> 如果Encrypted置为true，KMSKeyId为空时则使用服务默认密钥
element_fields.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en: The data disk specifications
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘规格
parameters.name: data_disk

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Day`, `Period` can be set only to `3`.

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, `Period` can be set to `1` to `9`, or `12`
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

- 如果**PeriodUnit**取值为**Day**时，则**Period**仅可设置为**3**。

- 如果**PeriodUnit**取值为**Month**时，则**Period**可设置为**1-9**,**12**
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The maximum public bandwidth. If this value is greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 公网最大带宽，如果本参数的值大于0，则自动为实例分配公网IP
parameters.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to create. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 创建的实例数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

> This parameter is applicable only to node-level scheduling. An error is reported if you specify this parameter for regional scheduling. If you do not specify a vSwitch, the system validates the network ID, but instance creation in this network is not guaranteed
parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。如果不指定交换机信息时，则只会校验网络ID是否合法，实际资源生产并不以此网络ID为准
parameters.name: net_work_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch.

> This parameter is applicable only to node-level scheduling. An error is reported if you specify this parameter for regional scheduling
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_id

parameters.help_en: The hostname
parameters.help_zh: 主机名称
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

By default, this parameter is set to the `InstanceId` of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。

默认值为实例的InstanceId
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to append an ordered suffix to `HostName` and `InstanceName`. The suffix starts from 001 and increments up to 999
parameters.help_zh: 是否为**HostName**和**InstanceName**添加有序后缀，有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999
parameters.name: unique_suffix

parameters.help_en: The user data for the instance. The data must be Base64-encoded and not exceed 16 KB in size
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大支持16 KB。您可传入**UserData**信息，**UserData**以Base64的方式编码
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: enables auto-renewal

- **false** (default): disables auto-renewal

> This parameter does not apply to pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

- **true**：自动续费
- **false**：不自动续费（默认）

>按量付费时，该参数无效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The price-based scheduling strategy. Valid values:

- **PriceHighPriority**: prioritizes nodes with higher prices

- **PriceLowPriority**: prioritizes nodes with lower prices
parameters.help_zh:
调度价格策略。取值：

- **PriceHighPriority**：优先高价
- **PriceLowPriority**：优先低价
parameters.name: scheduling_price_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Private IP address.

> This parameter can be used only for node-level scheduling. Configuring this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error.
> If you specify a private IP, the number of instances can only be 1, and the private IP takes effect only when both the private IP and the VSwitch ID are specified
parameters.help_zh:
私网IP地址。
>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。
如果指定了私网IP，实例数量只能为1台，且私网IP和交换机ID同时非空时，该私网IP才生效
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The unit of time for purchasing resources. Valid values:

- **Month** (default): Purchase by month.

- **Day**: Purchase by day
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值：
- **Month**（默认）：按月购买。
- **Day**：按天购买
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign a public IP address.
Valid values:

- **true** (default): assigns a public IP address.

- **false**: does not assign a public IP address
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用公网ipidentification。
取值：

- true：启用。

- false：不启用

默认值：true
parameters.name: public_ip_identification

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image. Valid values:

- **true**: uses the preset password.

- **false**: does not use the preset password.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预置密码。取值：

- **true**：使用
- **false**：不使用

> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
parameters.name: password_inherit

parameters.help_en:
The billing policy of the instance. Valid values:

- **instance**: The instance is billed individually.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the account-level billing policy is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
实例计费策略。取值：

- **instance**：实例粒度
- 不传默认按用户维度
parameters.name: instance_charge_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle for the computing resources of the instance. This parameter is applicable only to pay-as-you-go instances that are billed individually.
Valid values:

- **Day**: billed on a daily basis

- **Month**: billed on a monthly basis
parameters.help_zh:
实例计算资源计费周期，仅支持实例级后付费。
取值

- **Day**：按天计费。

- **Month**：按月计费
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The IP address type. Valid values:

- **ipv4** (default): IPv4.

- **ipv6**: IPv6.

- **ipv4Andipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (single stack).

- **ipv4Withipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual stack)
parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

- **ipv4**（默认值）：IPv4。

- **ipv6**：IPv6。

- **ipv4Andipv6**：IPv4和IPv6(单栈)。
- **ipv4Withipv6**：IPv4和IPv6(双栈)
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Default value: `true`
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用代金券，默认为使用，即AutoUseCoupon=true
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

element_fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The value cannot exceed 128 characters in length, start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The time when the pay-as-you-go instance is automatically released. The time must be in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and must be in UTC.

- If the seconds part (`ss`) is not `00`, the time is automatically set to the beginning of the current minute (`mm`).

- The release time must be at least one hour later than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的自动释放时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

- 如果秒（`ss`）取值不是`00`，则自动取为当前分钟（`mm`）开始时。

- 最短释放时间为当前时间一小时之后
parameters.name: auto_release_time

parameters.help_en:
The spot strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

- NoSpot (default): a regular pay-as-you-go instance

- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance for which the system automatically bids based on the real-time market price

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时生效。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the preemptible instance.

Unit: hours
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例保护期。

单位：小时
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses to assign to the primary private ENI
parameters.help_zh: 为私网主网卡指定随机生成的ipv6地址数量
parameters.name: ipv6_address_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable release protection for the instance to prevent it from being accidentally released from the console or by calling an API operation. Valid values:

- true: enables release protection.

- false: disables release protection.

Default value: false.

> This parameter is applicable only to pay-as-you-go instances and protects them only from manual releases. It does not protect them from system-initiated releases
parameters.help_zh:
实例释放保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API释放实例。取值范围： 

-  true：开启实例释放保护。
-  false：关闭实例释放保护。

默认值：false。

> 该属性仅适用于按量付费实例，且只能限制手动释放操作，对系统释放操作不生效
parameters.name: deletion_protection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the launch template
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板名称
parameters.name: launch_template_name

parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板版本
parameters.name: launch_template_version

v1_parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

> 节点级调度时必填，区域级调度时无效
v1_parameters.name: EnsRegionId

v1_parameters.help_en: The hostname
v1_parameters.help_zh: 主机名称
v1_parameters.name: HostName

v1_parameters.help_en: The image ID. This parameter is required for all instance types except for ARM-based ones
v1_parameters.help_zh: 镜像ID。arm版卡不能填，其他类型规格必填
v1_parameters.name: ImageId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing policy of the instance. Valid values:

- **instance**: The instance is billed individually.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the account-level billing policy is used by default
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例计费策略。取值：

- **instance**：实例粒度
- 不传默认按用户维度
v1_parameters.name: InstanceChargeStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the instance. Valid values:

- **PrePaid**: subscription

- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例付费方式。取值：
- **PrePaid**：预付费，包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费
v1_parameters.name: InstanceChargeType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

By default, this parameter is set to the `InstanceId` of the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）。

默认值为实例的InstanceId
v1_parameters.name: InstanceName

v1_parameters.help_en: The instance type
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
v1_parameters.name: InstanceType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing method for bandwidth. Valid values:

- **BandwidthByDay**: pay-by-day peak bandwidth

- **95BandwidthByMonth**: pay-by-monthly 95th percentile bandwidth

> You can select a billing method only when you purchase an instance for the first time. For subsequent purchases, the system uses the previously selected billing method by default
v1_parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
- **BandwidthByDay**：日峰值带宽
- **95BandwidthByMonth**：月95峰值带宽

> 如果是第一次新购时可以进行选择计费方式，后续此字段值会根据第一次所选择的计费方式进行默认处理
v1_parameters.name: InternetChargeType

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum public bandwidth. If this value is greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically assigned to the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh: 公网最大带宽，如果本参数的值大于0，则自动为实例分配公网IP
v1_parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut

v1_parameters.help_en:
The IP address type. Valid values:

- **ipv4** (default): IPv4.

- **ipv6**: IPv6.

- **ipv4Andipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (single stack).

- **ipv4Withipv6**: IPv4 and IPv6 (dual stack)
v1_parameters.help_zh:
IP类型。取值：

- **ipv4**（默认值）：IPv4。

- **ipv6**：IPv6。

- **ipv4Andipv6**：IPv4和IPv6(单栈)。
- **ipv4Withipv6**：IPv4和IPv6(双栈)
v1_parameters.name: IpType

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses to assign to the primary private ENI
v1_parameters.help_zh: 为私网主网卡指定随机生成的ipv6地址数量
v1_parameters.name: Ipv6AddressCount

v1_parameters.help_en:
The name of the key pair.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
v1_parameters.help_zh:
密钥对名称。
> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: KeyPairName

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the launch template
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the launch template
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板名称
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName

v1_parameters.help_en: The version of the launch template
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板版本
v1_parameters.name: LaunchTemplateVersion

v1_parameters.help_en:
The district code.

> This parameter is required for regional scheduling and is invalid for node-level scheduling
v1_parameters.help_zh:
地区Code。
>区域级调度时必填，节点级调度时无效
v1_parameters.name: NetDistrictCode

v1_parameters.help_en:
The network ID.

> This parameter is applicable only to node-level scheduling. An error is reported if you specify this parameter for regional scheduling. If you do not specify a vSwitch, the system validates the network ID, but instance creation in this network is not guaranteed
v1_parameters.help_zh:
网络ID。

>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。如果不指定交换机信息时，则只会校验网络ID是否合法，实际资源生产并不以此网络ID为准
v1_parameters.name: NetWorkId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The instance password.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例密码。

> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: Password

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the preset password of the image. Valid values:

- **true**: uses the preset password.

- **false**: does not use the preset password.

> You must specify at least one of the `Password`, `KeyPairName`, and `PasswordInherit` parameters
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否使用镜像预置密码。取值：

- **true**：使用
- **false**：不使用

> **Password**、**KeyPairName**、**PasswordInherit**至少填入一个
v1_parameters.name: PasswordInherit

v1_parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Day`, `Period` can be set only to `3`.

- If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, `Period` can be set to `1` to `9`, or `12`
v1_parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。

- 如果**PeriodUnit**取值为**Day**时，则**Period**仅可设置为**3**。

- 如果**PeriodUnit**取值为**Month**时，则**Period**可设置为**1-9**,**12**
v1_parameters.name: Period

v1_parameters.help_en:
The unit of time for purchasing resources. Valid values:

- **Month** (default): Purchase by month.

- **Day**: Purchase by day
v1_parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值：
- **Month**（默认）：按月购买。
- **Day**：按天购买
v1_parameters.name: PeriodUnit

v1_parameters.help_en:
Private IP address.

> This parameter can be used only for node-level scheduling. Configuring this parameter for region-level scheduling causes an error.
> If you specify a private IP, the number of instances can only be 1, and the private IP takes effect only when both the private IP and the VSwitch ID are specified
v1_parameters.help_zh:
私网IP地址。
>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错。
如果指定了私网IP，实例数量只能为1台，且私网IP和交换机ID同时非空时，该私网IP才生效
v1_parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign a public IP address.
Valid values:

- **true** (default): assigns a public IP address.

- **false**: does not assign a public IP address
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否启用公网ipidentification。
取值：

- true：启用。

- false：不启用

默认值：true
v1_parameters.name: PublicIpIdentification

v1_parameters.help_en:
The scheduling level. This determines whether to perform regional or node-level scheduling. Valid values:

- **Big**: large area

- **Middle**: province

- **Small**: city

- **Region**: node
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度层级。通过该字段来执行节点级调度或者区域调度。取值：

- **Big**：大区
- **Middle**：省份
- **Small**：城市
- **Region**：节点
v1_parameters.name: ScheduleAreaLevel

v1_parameters.help_en:
The price-based scheduling strategy. Valid values:

- **PriceHighPriority**: prioritizes nodes with higher prices

- **PriceLowPriority**: prioritizes nodes with lower prices
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度价格策略。取值：

- **PriceHighPriority**：优先高价
- **PriceLowPriority**：优先低价
v1_parameters.name: SchedulingPriceStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en:
The scheduling strategy. Valid values:

- **Concentrate**: concentrated deployment

- **Disperse**: dispersed deployment

> For node-level scheduling, set this parameter to **Concentrate**. For regional scheduling, select a strategy based on your business requirements
v1_parameters.help_zh:
调度策略。取值：

- **Concentrate**：集中
- **Disperse**：分散

> 节点级调度时，为**Concentrate**；区域级调度时，按客户需求选择
v1_parameters.name: SchedulingStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
v1_parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
v1_parameters.name: SecurityId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The protection period of the preemptible instance.

Unit: hours
v1_parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例保护期。

单位：小时
v1_parameters.name: SpotDuration

v1_parameters.help_en:
The spot strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

- NoSpot (default): a regular pay-as-you-go instance

- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance for which the system automatically bids based on the real-time market price

Default value: NoSpot
v1_parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例的竞价策略。当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时生效。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
v1_parameters.name: SpotStrategy

v1_parameters.help_en: The system disk specifications
v1_parameters.help_zh: 系统盘规格
v1_parameters.name: SystemDisk

v1_parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instance
v1_parameters.help_zh: 实例所绑定的标签
v1_parameters.name: Tag

v1_parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to append an ordered suffix to `HostName` and `InstanceName`. The suffix starts from 001 and increments up to 999
v1_parameters.help_zh: 是否为**HostName**和**InstanceName**添加有序后缀，有序后缀从001开始递增，最大不能超过999
v1_parameters.name: UniqueSuffix

v1_parameters.help_en: The user data for the instance. The data must be Base64-encoded and not exceed 16 KB in size
v1_parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大支持16 KB。您可传入**UserData**信息，**UserData**以Base64的方式编码
v1_parameters.name: UserData

v1_parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch.

> This parameter is applicable only to node-level scheduling. An error is reported if you specify this parameter for regional scheduling
v1_parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。

>只能在节点级调度使用，区域级调度时配置该参数会报错
v1_parameters.name: VSwitchId
